request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for browser extension, web/PWA, iOS, Android, and beta channel
Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano node operation, DBSync indexers, application servers, metadata aggregation, Hub backend services, and monitoring
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public community channels, project support, wiki maintenance, and educational videos
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics in February 2027 and August 2027
request.what: 12 months of operations, maintenance, support, infrastructure, audits/oversight metrics, and continued development for the Eternl Cardano light wallet.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet available on web, browser extension, Android, and iOS.
The proposal requests ₳2,350,000, calculated at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 in annual costs.
The funded work covers 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
If roughly 5,500 users, or about 4.2% of the stated install base, buy the planned Pro plan, that income would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
The team will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.
Treasury-fund-use audits will be performed by an independent party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team in February 2027 and August 2027.
Every paid Pro plan will be recorded on-chain with metadata, and reports on Pro plan earnings plus repayment or donation transaction hashes will be published.
Eternl says 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The main Eternl UI will not be open-source, though some libraries used in Eternl will be published through the npm registry.

summary: The proposal asks for ₳2,350,000 for a 12-month Eternl operating runway, with stated public-wallet custody, partial repayment mechanics, future audits, and a Pro-plan sustainability path, but several adoption and impact claims are asserted without document-level evidence.
